table.name: Secondary Knock Threshold (Event 1)
table.description:
Second knock detector level by rpm for event slot 1; a signal above it triggers the secondary knock retard steps. Unit: sum of the three strongest knock-channel ratios to their background (3.0 = all at background).
Details: Knock decision (0x0E8654 / 0x0E80B4, read): for the event slot FFF8CDC0 (1-4) the knock intensity FFF8C1C0[slot] (output of the signal processing 0x0E51E4) is compared with two thresholds. Knock B, FFF8A7B5 = intensity > Knock Threshold (this family, FFF8C1CC[slot] by 0x0E77E0) or FFF8CDC4[slot] >= cal 0x1BD92 (65535, off). Knock A, FFF8A7AD = intensity > Secondary Knock Threshold (FFF8C1D4[slot] by 0x0E78E4). Each event also sets bits of FFF8A79D (0x10/0x20/0x30/0x40 by slot). Slot vs cylinder number not mapped. 0x0E78E4 looks this 16-point curve up by FFF8CDC2 with the implicit-axis routine 0x7304 (0...240 in steps of 16 = 500...8,000 rpm, read). Confidence: inferred.

Rev/Boost Limit Torque Caps Enable [byte, bit 0 = 1]
table.description:
Bit 0 of this byte (value 1) is the switch: add 1 to set it, subtract 1 to clear it; leave the other bits as they are. Lets the rev limiter and overboost cut close the throttle (the Rev/Boost Limit Torque tables).
With this bit set, 0x0BDA84 replaces the throttle-side request FFF8AE4C by the Rev/Boost Limit Torque cap FFF8AE8C (0x0BAFA8) in limit state 0x0B; the torque monitor 0x189488 reads the same bit (read). Cleared, the rev limiter and the overboost cut become fuel-only: no throttle closing during the cut (inferred). Confidence: inferred.

table.name: Overboost Flag Reset Margin
table.description:
Once set, the overboost flag clears only when boost falls to Overboost Limit plus this.
Details: When used: always. 0x0C0FE0 (read): once set, the overboost flag FFF8A63A bit 6 (Overboost Limit + Overboost Margin for Overboost Delay) stays set until MAP FFF88FF4 <= Overboost Limit + this. The flag forces the zero torque cap in the overboost/rev cut state (0x0BAE98 -> FFF8AE8A, applied in limit state 0x0B; Overboost Cut Margin (Limit State)) and also feeds 0x1B8310 (0x1B828C / 0x1B83CC, the overboost diagnostic, inferred in my research notes), so this margin also sets how long that monitor sees overboost. Confidence: inferred.

Base (open-loop) idle air by coolant right after a cold start (below 75 degC) until the car moves or the engine warms, and while stopped, used while the TGVs are commanded closed (the normal state at low torque, probably including warm idle). Change it together with the matching Idle Speed Target and the normal Idle Base Air table for this mode.
Details: When used: idle mode 1 (engine stopped, or dropped out of the running state) and mode 2 (after a start with coolant below 75 C / 167 F, until the car moves or, once the warm-up flag FFF88EA2 bit 1 has cleared, coolant reaches 50 C / 122 F; held at least 200 time-since-start counts) (read, 0x0F354C). 0x0F0D24: base idle air B20C by idle mode FFF8A7F0 and coolant, this table while FFF8A881 bit 4 (TGV close command) is set (read).
